name: Song of Solomon
title: Song of Solomon — Covenant Delight

author.traditional: Traditional: Solomon (superscription); poetic drama of bride/bridegroom.

date.range_display: Early in Solomon’s reign fits Adam’s chronology preference (before later foreign-wife downfall).

audience: Covenant people learning pure marital love; church hearing Christ’s love for His bride (historic reading).
purpose: Celebrate exclusive, passionate, faithful love — not lust.
christ: Bridegroom love (Eph 5; Rev 19) without turning the poem into pure allegory that erases marriage.
jesus_in_this_book: Bridegroom love (Eph 5; Rev 19) without turning the poem into pure allegory that erases marriage.
how_to_read: As wisdom on marriage first; then hear echo in Christ and church.
watchman_charge: Flee the counterfeit. Guard covenant desire. Love is strong as death — keep it holy.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
